t: 谢里斯以色列会堂(Shearis Israel)是北美大陆第一座犹太会堂,是一座献堂.
te: Shearith Israel, the first synagogue in continental North America, is dedicated.
dz: 谢里斯以色列会堂(Shearis Israel)是北美大陆第一座犹太会堂,是一座献堂.
de: Shearith Israel, the first synagogue in continental North America, is dedicated.

t: 估计8.7级地震引发了一场海啸,造成智利海岸线1000多公里(620米)被破坏.
te: An estimated magnitude 8.7 earthquake causes a tsunami that damages more than 1,000 km (620 mi) of Chile's coastline.
dz: 估计8.7级地震引发了一场海啸,造成智利海岸线1000多公里(620米)被破坏.
de: An estimated magnitude 8.7 earthquake causes a tsunami that damages more than 1,000 km (620 mi) of Chile's coastline.

t: 艾哈迈德三世被迫退位为奥斯曼苏丹.
te: Ahmed III is forced to abdicate as the Ottoman sultan.
dz: 艾哈迈德三世被迫退位为奥斯曼苏丹.
de: Ahmed III is forced to abdicate as the Ottoman sultan.

t: 拉多加运河在俄罗斯竣工.
te: Construction of the Ladoga Canal is completed in Russia.
dz: 拉多加运河在俄罗斯竣工.
de: Construction of the Ladoga Canal is completed in Russia.

t: 未来的普鲁士大帝弗雷德里克被其父亲赦免并解除监禁.
te: The future Frederick the Great of Prussia is granted a pardon by his father and is released from confinement.
dz: 未来的普鲁士大帝弗雷德里克被其父亲赦免并解除监禁.
